title: Stern--Brocot run geometry: direction-flip involution and unit-run height recursion

concepts.label: Stern--Brocot direction flip
concepts.note: The map exchanging the left and right mediant directions.

concepts.label: two-direction flip involution
concepts.note: Flipping either constructor selects the other, and two flips restore the original direction.

concepts.label: unit-run height recursion
concepts.note: The exact height increment caused by prepending a run of length one.

concepts.label: combinatorial infrastructure boundary
concepts.note: These exact bookkeeping identities do not establish a measure symmetry, a Fibonacci estimate, analytic tail survival, or irrationality.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED TWO-DIRECTION INVOLUTION: LR.left.flip is LR.right, LR.right.flip is LR.left, and for every Stern--Brocot direction d, applying flip twice returns d.
statement_nodes.engine: Definitional reduction on the two constructors of LR; the double-flip law follows by cases on d.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary bookkeeping for a two-element direction type; no novelty or priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The three equalities concern only the direction labels. They do not prove that flipping a whole word swaps its coordinates, preserves a tree measure or run mass, or produces any arithmetic or irrationality consequence.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED UNIT-RUN RECURSION: for every list of run lengths ns, runHeight (1 :: ns) equals runHeight ns plus the first coordinate of runBoundaryPair ns.
statement_nodes.engine: Unfold runHeight and the continuant recurrence runBoundaryPair at a head run of length one, then normalize the resulting natural-number sum.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Immediate one-step continuant bookkeeping; no novelty or priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This is one exact recursion identity. It supplies no lower bound by itself, does not state the replicated-unit Fibonacci formula or the later defect expansion, and says nothing about run-tail mass after denominator clearing or irrationality of the totient series.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The flip laws normalize alternation of left and right direction labels, while the unit-run recursion records the corresponding direction-free continuant height update; neither theorem derives the other.
